description: This file defines the FavoritesController class which handles HTTP requests related to favoriting articles in an ASP.NET Core application. It provides endpoints to add and remove articles from favorites, utilizing MediatR commands and authorization.

classes.name: FavoritesController
classes.description: Controller for managing favorite articles, providing endpoints to add and remove favorites, secured by JWT authorization.

methods.name: FavoriteAdd
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST request to mark an article as favorite.

methods.name: FavoriteDelete
methods.description: Handles HTTP DELETE request to remove an article from favorites.
